title: Oncall handoff + mini threat model (SSO) - Feb 17 2026
content:
Meeting: Sec Eng weekly sync (ad-hoc handoff + mini threat modeling)
Date: 2026-02-17 09:30-10:20 PT
Location: Zoom / #sec-eng Slack thread
Attendees: Priya (owner), Daniel K., Marcus L., Ava C., Lina G., plus brief drop-in from ops (Rafi)
Absentees: N/A

Purpose: Quick oncall handoff for the week of 2/17, triage open vulnerabilities and secrets findings, and run a focused 20-minute threat-model exercise for SSO onboarding (follow-up to last quarter's identity hardening initiative). This is intentionally short-form notes for action tracking.

1) Oncall handoff / housekeeping
- Summary of current oncall posture: No active incidents. Two flaps last week related to auth cache warming; mitigated via temporary cache TTL bump.
- Pager backlog: 0 P1s, 1 P2 (intermittent rate-limit spikes on embeddings route - see SEC-2145), multiple low-priority alerts due to noisy SCA scanner (tuned rules in progress).
- Rotation: Daniel is primary oncall 2/17-2/24; Marcus is secondary. Priya will be on standby for vault/KMS escalation this week.
- Runbook updates: Added step for redis kv-cache flush in case of stale token eviction (link: GH PR 789). Marcus to follow up to add that step into PagerDuty playbook by EOD 2/18.

2) Vulnerability triage snapshot
- VULN-431: transient RCE heuristic flagged in an internal test harness library. Initial triage: false positive on test fixture; still requires dependency upgrade. Action: Ava to open PR to bump lib to 2.3.1 and run downstream smoke tests. Target: 2/22. Linked: JIRA VULN-431.
- VULN-remote-legacy: flagged by SCA scan in a deprecated analytics container. Decision: decommission container in next infra deprecations sprint. Lina to own decommission plan (target: 3/05).
- Scanner tuning: current noise from dev-only dependencies. Agreed to implement environment-based allowlist in the scanner (Daniel + infra team). Tracker: SEC-2170 (infra).

3) Secrets findings & short-term mitigations
- SECRETS-198: detected an unrotated service account key referenced in a build job for an internal test harness. Root cause: build job uses legacy credentials stored in a plain-text var in Jenkins.
  - Immediate action: rotate the service account key and update the Jenkins job to use KMS-encrypted secret reference. Owner: Priya. Deadline: rotate by 2/18 AM PST; update job by 2/19.
  - Postmortem task: add a CI job scanner rule to fail builds referencing legacy plaintext keys. Tracker: JIRA SECRETS-198. Owner: Marcus. Target: 2/26.
- Secrets mapping: discussed quick wins to reduce secret sprawl — audit of top 10 build jobs + their credential usage. Lina will generate export of jobs and owners by 2/20. Daniel will sketch a phased remediation plan focusing on high-privilege keys first.

4) Mini threat model workshop: SSO onboarding flow (20-minute focused run)
- Scope: the customer-facing SSO onboarding flow used by Dedicated customers when setting up SAML/OIDC with our control plane. Not a full TD but focused on 3 high-risk scenarios.
- Assets in scope: control-plane API, onboarding service (on dedicated infra), configuration UI, metadata exchange endpoint, IdP config blob, temporary bootstrap tokens, onboarding audit logs.
- Threats & notes:
  - Threat A: Metadata poisoning - attacker supplies malformed IdP metadata to trick SP into misconfig or to capture tokens. Likelihood: low-medium if validation not strict. Impact: high (could allow account takeover). Mitigation: strict schema validation, signature checks of metadata where available, UI hygiene to show issuer/source. Action: Ava to prototype metadata validation library (lib-sso-validate). Target: 2/28.
  - Threat B: Bootstrap token disclosure during SSO binding - short-lived token handed to the admin via email/link could be intercepted. Likelihood: medium. Impact: medium-high. Mitigation: reduce token lifetime to 5 minutes, require secondary verification from admin's console session (same-origin). Action: Priya to propose policy change for bootstrap tokens and update onboarding doc. Target: 2/24.
  - Threat C: Misconfigured SAML assertion attributes leading to privilege escalation between orgs. Likelihood: medium. Impact: high. Mitigation: enforce attribute allowlist, map attributes server-side, and add post-assertion sanity checks. Action: Marcus + engineering to add server-side attribute mapping and test harness. Target: 3/10.
- Outcome: Agreed on 3 immediate mitigations (validation lib, token lifetime policy, attribute mapping). Added to backlog and tagged for priority for Dedicated onboarding. Link to confluence draft: CONFLUENCE:sec/sso-threat-model.

5) Decisions & short notes
- Increase SCA scan cadence for production images to daily from weekly for two weeks to reduce noise and catch regressions after dependency bumps (decision minutes). Owner: Lina.
- Add bootstrapped token lifetime change to identity policy; change to 5-minute TTL pending product approval. Priya to circulate proposal by 2/19.
- Vault rotation: agreed to run a targeted key rotation for the test-harness service account only this cycle (not full org rotation). Rafi (ops) to coordinate the Jenkins rollout.

6) Action items (owner / due / status)
- Marcus: Add redis kv-cache flush to PagerDuty runbook. Due 2026-02-18. (in_progress)
- Ava: PR to bump vulnerable test harness lib (VULN-431). Due 2026-02-22. (todo)
- Priya: Rotate compromised service account key and update Jenkins job referencing it. Due 2026-02-18 (rotate), 2026-02-19 (job update). (todo)
- Marcus: Create CI scanner rule to block plaintext secrets in builds (SECRETS-198). Due 2026-02-26. (todo)
- Lina: Export top-10 build jobs for secrets map and coordinate SCA cadence change. Due 2026-02-20. (todo)
- Daniel: Draft infra ticket SEC-2170 for scanner allowlist + env-aware rules. Due 2026-02-19. (todo)
- Ava: Implement lib-sso-validate prototype. Due 2026-02-28. (todo)
- Priya: Policy proposal for bootstrap token lifetime change. Due 2026-02-19. (todo)

7) Parking lot / follow-ups
- Request from product: evaluate UX impact of shortened bootstrap token TTL (need product sign-off) — product PM assigned (TBD).
- Deeper SSO threat model to be scheduled as a separate 90-minute session with product and infra (target window: early March).
- Request to surface cost/latency impact of server-side attribute mapping (infra dependency assessment).

Notes to self: keep the oncall handover short and link to runbook fragments instead of copying runbook text into drive. This doc is a working artifact; will convert key decisions into confluence summary if any of the proposed mitigations move to "in_progress".

Next sync: regular sec-eng weekly on 2026-02-24 09:30 PT. If any action item becomes P1, escalate to incident channel.

End of notes.
